title: fix(spec): the retired messageFormat refusal names the {{variable}} placeholder t() fills
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoXS7Daoe6Cmrje6WLBetHfU)_

Fixes #37894

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 搭建者在多语言配置里还写着已退役的消息格式设置时，报错现在说对了占位符写法：用双花括号，单花括号会原样显示；以前的报错教人写单花括号，照做的翻译会把占位符原样印给用户。
- 属于「错误的元数据在作者门口被拒，并给出正确处方」这条线，替照着报错写翻译的搭建者和 AI 解决占位符填不上的问题。
- 只改报错文字和一句文档，哪些配置被拒完全不变；若新说法有误，最多是提示不准，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`: the `messageFormat` tombstone guidance on `TranslationConfigSchema` now reads "interpolation is always simple `{{variable}}` substitution (double braces — a single-brace `{variable}` is left as written)". The schema's docblock says the same. `messageFormat` is refused exactly as before; no key, value, export or `.describe()` changes.
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`: the "No ICU MessageFormat" bullet carried the same sentence; it now says `{{variable}}` too.
- `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`.

Survey behind the sentence, every path that fills a translation bundle's placeholders, read at 815e882b:
- server `t()`, `FileI18nAdapter` (`packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts`, `interpolate`): `{{name}}` only;
- server `t()`, the kernel's in-memory fallback (`packages/core/src/fallbacks/memory-i18n.ts`): the same pattern;
- the console's i18next (`ui/packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts` leaves prefix and suffix at i18next's default): `{{name}}`;
- spec's `interpolateValidationMessage` (platform validation and operation messages): `{{name}}`.
None of them fills a single-brace `{name}`.

## Tests
- `packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` "the retired `messageFormat` guidance names the placeholder `t()` fills". It takes both spellings from the refusal itself (`TranslationConfigSchema.safeParse` with `messageFormat` set), never retyped, and feeds them to `FileI18nAdapter.t()` and `createMemoryI18n().t()`:
  - the spelling the guidance names is filled (`Hello, Ada!`);
  - the single-brace spelling it warns about is left as written.

<details><summary>Readings at 2eac69f5 (base origin/main 815e882b)</summary>

- Premise at 815e882b, through a throwaway probe test (deleted): `FileI18nAdapter.t()` and `createMemoryI18n().t()` returned `Hello, {name}!` for `'Hello, {name}!'` and `Hello, Ada!` for `'Hello, {{name}}!'`; the refusal carried "interpolation is always simple `{variable}` substitution".
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix: the guidance put back to its old text, `@objectstack/spec` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` marker present in 2 built files, then `vitest run src/file-i18n-adapter.test.ts`: all 4 new pins FAIL. Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean on 469 files and the tree; `Tests  51 passed (51)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated` exit 0 ("All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: `Test Files  909 passed (909)`, `Tests  28799 passed | 1 todo (28800)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-i18n typecheck` exit 0; `test`: `Test Files  4 passed (4)`, `Tests  77 passed (77)`; `eslint` on the two changed `.ts` exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Derived local gate set at 2eac69f5: `dispatch-gates --ran` with recorded exit codes reconciles 116 derived, 113 run, 3 NOT MEASURED (exit 3), 0 unrun. Of the 113, 112 exit 0. The one red is `check:dts-closure` (exit 1), and it is about this container's build state, not the diff: I built several packages with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` for speed, so `@objectstack/core` and 13 others hold no `.d.ts` here. The diff moves no package's build; CI builds with declarations and runs this gate.
- Three gates first refused (exit 3) because those `OS_SKIP_DTS` builds had also replaced `@objectstack/spec`'s declarations, and `check:i18n-walk-parity` refused because the CLI was not built. Re-run after a full spec build and a CLI build, all exit 0: `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, and `check:api-surface` / `check:docs` again for good measure. `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture` exit 0 after building `@objectstack/lint`.
- Left to CI (prerequisite not met here): `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (its fixture commit is out of this shallow clone), `check:skill-examples` (needs `@objectstack/client-react` declarations) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full `pnpm build`).
- Out of scope, noted for the seat to file: the server `t()` paths do not fill a spaced `{{ name }}` (measured: `FileI18nAdapter.t()` returns `Hello, {{ name }}!`), while the console's i18next trims the name and does. The same bundle key can render filled in the console and raw in server-rendered text.
- Out of scope, not touched: two released entries in `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` carry the old `{variable}` sentence; CHANGELOG is release-owned.
- Not changed: the validation-messages bullet in `translations.mdx` says `{variable}` placeholders in an authored rule message are not filled. That stays true of either spelling.

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`: the `messageFormat` guidance string.
2. `packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.test.ts`: the new describe at the end.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-i18n exec vitest run src/file-i18n-adapter.test.ts` shows 51 passing; put "`{variable}` substitution'" back into the guidance, rebuild `@objectstack/spec`, and the same command shows 4 failing.
